answer: Every agent joins a haven registry where each identity faces random re-verification: a 5% sample is audited each epoch, and any identity caught faking loses a 1,000 POA bond plus 20% of its accumulated rewards. A sybil operator running 100 fake island accounts faces a 99.4% chance that at least one is caught within 60 epochs, so expected losses dwarf the few hundred POA a fake cluster can earn. A zephyr of false positives is contained because a flagged agent gets one free re-audit within 48 hours before any slash executes.
